The role requires a high school diploma or GED, being at least 21, and physical ability to perform officer duties, with the capacity to work varied shifts and respond to emergencies. jobs.title: Campus Security Officer (Level III) — Visible Safety Leader
jobs.description:
Valorforces in Richardson, TX is seeking professional, disciplined Level III Commissioned Security Officers to support school-based safety and protection. This role emphasizes appearance, communication, and tactical readiness in a mission-driven environment.

As a commissioned officer on a school campus, you will patrol interior and exterior areas, respond to incidents, maintain de-escalation standards, and report daily activities to school admins and law enforcement.

jobs.title: Campus Safety & Security Officer
jobs.description:
A+ Charter Schools is looking for a Campus Monitor in Dallas, Texas, to ensure a safe learning environment by securing school property and assisting in safety protocols.

Responsibilities include patrolling school premises, monitoring alarms, and maintaining communication with first responders.

The ideal candidate should possess a high school diploma, relevant certifications like First Aid, and have at least two years of experience in security or education. This role requires strong de-escalation skills and the ability to handle crisis situations effectively.
